_meta.note: One entry per reel in manifest.json, keyed by reel id. A reel is placed where its pictures and sound were MADE: the studio or transmitter city for a broadcast, the location shot for a newsreel item filmed abroad (so the Spanish NO-DO item on a Berlin cybernetics show sits on Berlin, with the producer named in `place`). `conf` is how precisely the evidence places it: "city" = point-level, a place actually named in the title/notes (also used for a precise named non-urban site, e.g. a test range or a transmitter); "region" = a sub-national area or a named region with the city inferred; "country" = only the nation is evidenced, coordinates are the broadcaster's or producer's home city as a best guess; "unknown" = not placeable, coordinates are a cultural-region anchor only and should not be drawn as a fact. country "XX" means genuinely unplaceable. `dx: true` marks a long-distance (TV-DX) catch: the main entry is the TRANSMITTER; where the recordist's location is documented, `heard` carries the receiving point for an arc. `heard` also appears on shortwave reels whose notes name where the listener sat. `realm` (orbit | moon | deep-space) marks reels whose sound did not originate on Earth; their lat/lon is the Earth anchor (ground station, relay or launch site) named after the arrow in `place`. Reels flagged takedown in the manifest are included here for completeness. Round 5 (2026-09-25) added 102 reels, placed by their cutters under the same rules.
